name: Rin Sumiya
text: Hana's bodyguard for three years, dismissed a week before the gala for saying what she saw. Dry, terse, unimpressed. She walks in through the lobby with her family's sword.

name: Hana Amagiri
text: The founder's daughter, confined to the roof. She taught Rin calligraphy in the long hours. Her one text started the climb: *Come up. Please.*

name: Dr. Sōichi Amagiri
text: He built Hōrai Life to keep his dying daughter alive. A broken father, not a simple villain. His announcements still loop: *You are safe. You are forever.*

name: The Maintenance Chief
text: Still on shift, because stopping the pumps would cut off water to the flats upstairs. Plants his boots and swings a pipe wrench across the bay.

name: Whisper
text: Quotes conduct policy, calls HR, and steps to Rin's blind side. Holds the garden override and, later, residential appeals.

name: Falcifer
text: Composted once. Came back perennial. Hooded and faceless under a mantle of thorns, with a sickle dripping sap. Vines burst from the floor where it points.

name: The Winter Widow
role: Night nurse. Yes, we have a sexy nurse too
text: Not a widow herself: she makes them. Circles in rounds, feints up close, and throws frost that freezes Rin for a free cut.

name: Subject 001
text: Still talks like a consent form and would prefer person-first language. Charges, then reels when it misses.

name: The Chair
text: Still keeps the minutes. Rings for order and a brass wave crosses the chamber. Close in he fights with open hands, and his guard turns a cut aside until he has finished speaking.

name: The Freight Porter
text: He carried the Clinic's course to every door and took a signature for each. He has the book. *i am too old for this shit.*

name: The Collector
text: A courteous Elder who has already labelled Rin's empty plaque. The only one in the tower who agrees with her about the z-word.

name: The Pacer
text: Sprints past Rin and comes back down the same lane. Close in, a javelin and a coach's patience: *false start. you go when i have gone.*

name: The Sky Elder
text: Tends a rooftop pool built for someone who missed the sea, and calls undercurrents across the tiles.

name: The Conductor
text: Still leads the orchestra after the chairs emptied. His baton cuts, and his rests are counted: strike him in one and he answers.

name: The Sun Messiah
text: The gala paid for sunrise on demand. Its performer still turns the lamps, sending spokes of light through the ballroom.

name: Homura
text: The Expedition's cyborg duellist. Her thermal blade only cauterises the undying, so she wants Rin's. Three duels, each faster and harder than the last.

name: The Envoy
text: Offers Rin a deal at the tower core and wants his people out with the sample.

name: Galahad
text: A person inside an Expedition breach frame, with a photograph tucked under the shield handle.
